label: R17-TIMING-BATCH
title: Integrate and validate Round17 FP timing lanes on the repaired fetch fence
dependency_override: T-010 and T-011 are independently accepted_for_candidate. T-009/T-012 become done only after their correctness matrices pass on this exact integrated candidate; no owner-only result is promoted directly.
scope: Cherry-pick the two disjoint Round17 lanes onto the repaired T-009/T-012 candidate: split ordinary FP round-pack normalization with IT_PACK_PRE, and remove TX_DONE response-ready cleanup from accumulator enables. Resolve tests serially, then rebuild and run the full affected functional union on one exact SHA before any physical claim.
writes: integration-only conflict resolution in member-declared files

joint_validation.l0_l1: registry, compile, core/backpressure, FIFO base+cache, MMU, IRQ young/atomic, maintenance owner, FP exec, P7-1/2/3/4/5, muldiv; P7-2 fault BFM remains expected-fail
joint_validation.l2: p5a; muldiv/rtl/hazard; pair/LSE/LSE128/maintenance; IRQ atomic/STXR; NEON fetch fault; P7-1/3/4/5 complete strict lockstep matrices
joint_validation.physical: after L0-L2 green, use a fresh isolated remote probe for synthesis/fitter/signoff STA/top-50 with MinFreeMb=16384
joint_validation.resource: one local heavy queue, CPU<=50%, MemoryMax=16G, MemorySwapMax=0, VERILATOR_JOBS=1; one remote Quartus job only

acceptance: All registered joint tests pass on one exact candidate SHA, including the T-012 FP-response/data-MMU overlap. The new physical run must show which Round16 cones disappeared or moved; no timing improvement is claimed from RTL structure alone. feature/p7-final advances only by ff-only after evidence finalization.

review.summary: Exact-SHA L0-L2 and corrected NEON fetch-fault semantic guard pass. Fresh T-014 physical improves Fmax/setup/TNS but setup remains negative; R18 T-016/T-017/T-018 are dispatched.

board_policy: No assembler, SOF/JIC/RBF/POF/JBC/SVF/JAM, JTAG, programming, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
